fec_send_seam.root_cause: Two defects kept repair at 0: (1) ShouldDisableRedAndUlpfec disabled ULPFEC for generic+NACK; (2) the FecController's zero-loss dynamic rate (fec_rate=0) clobbered the encoder's per-block semantic rate via the shared pending_fec_params_ slot.
fec_send_seam.verification: End-to-end localhost loopback: repair generated with correct rates (P0 fec_rate=128 -> 17/34 and 7/13, P1 fec_rate=32 -> 2/13 and 1/6), fetched via FetchFecPackets, sent through the pacer/SRTP, and observed at the receiver's UlpfecReceiver (ParseAndHandleEncapsulatingHeader). Persistent egress alignment: fec_packets_sent/fec_bytes_sent exposed on RTCOutboundRtpStreamStats and asserted > 0 in localhost_media_flow_test.

fec_receive_stat_gap.note: RTCInboundRtpStreamStats.fec_packets_received is populated only for FlexFEC (webrtc_video_engine.cc:3943-3968), not ULPFEC. The app's fec_packets_received mapping therefore stays nullopt for ULPFEC; wiring UlpfecReceiver::GetPacketCounter() into receive stats is deferred to Task 13 (native FEC recovery). The SEND side is now observable via the non-standard provisional fec_packets_sent/fec_bytes_sent on RTCOutboundRtpStreamStats.
